Today we finish the final assembly of our 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco with the installation of the interior.
The guys work hard to finish the 1974 build before it's on its way to the SEMA Show.
The guys show off the completed 1974 Bronco on the floor at SEMA, then send it by truck to Mecum.
